svg.text: Phase is the start angle. Frequency is how fast the angle turns.
1. A point turns around a circle
The height of the point is sin(angle): the value of the wave.
At t = 0 the angle is φ. Arrows show the direction of travel.
2. The three waves: f = 2 Hz, A = 1
Each wave makes 1 cycle in 0.5 s. Only the start differs.
Phase changes the start. It does not change the speed.
